p: Gongqing National Forest Park (共青森林公园)
Northeast corner of Nenjiang Road (嫩江路) and Jungong Road (军工路). Ticketing booth along Nenjiang Road just east of Jungong Road, or along Jungong Road north of Nenjiang Road.

A large forest park that provides an escape from the urban confines of the city. Great for picnics and relaxation. Features thrill coasters, miniature train ride, pleasure boats, mini-golf, bumper cars.
